name: Camping Erlebnis Zugspitze
beschreibung: The Camping Erlebnis Zugspitze is located in Garmisch-Partenkirchen in the federal state of Tirol and belongs to the Camping category. The facility offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans as well as tent areas in a quiet setting. The proximity to the Zugspitzmassiv allows easy excursions on foot or by train. The site has modern sanitary facilities and a small shop for basic supplies. Leisure activities include hiking and cycling directly from the site. Access to the public transport network is provided by a nearby bus stop.
